concept: NAT Gateway: internet egress for Lambda in a VPC
tests: How to give a VPC-attached Lambda access to an external API on the internet.
expected: Lambda in private subnets + a 0.0.0.0/0 route to a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Lambda's ENI doesn't get a public IP. Triggers: "Lambda in a VPC", "call third-party API on the internet", "no internet access".
why_not: Lambda in a public subnet won't get a public IP; you can't attach an IGW to a function; a gateway endpoint — S3/DynamoDB only.
